description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2300/26 of 06.10.2022 - Rathgama D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the amendment of land title registration maps, changing the Divisional Secretariat Division designation from "Hikkaduwa" to "Rathgama" for specific land blocks. It falls under the Registration of Title Act and is issued by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement, making it primarily about land and property-related matters.
